extra/lab3_lora_complete.txt.title: LoRA settings
note: **How big the adapters are, and which parts of the model get one.**
- `r`: adapter size. `lora_alpha`: how much the adapter's changes count (usually 2 x r)
- `target_modules`: the names of the parts that get an adapter. Each model family names them differently

extra/lab3_lora_complete.txt.title: Add the adapters
note: **Leaves the model's own numbers unchanged and adds small add-ons beside them. Only the add-ons are trained.**
- The printed line shows how much of the model will be trained: about 2% at r=16

extra/lab3_lora_complete.txt.title: Grade only the answer
note: **Marks the ticket part with -100, the code for "don't grade", so only the answer is graded.**

extra/lab4_qlora_complete.txt.title: 4-bit settings
note: **Stores the model's numbers at 4 bits each, to save memory. Training never changes them.**
- `nf4`: a 4-bit format designed for the kind of numbers models hold
- Calculations still run at 16 bits

extra/lab4_qlora_complete.txt.title: Fold the adapter in
note: **Loads the trained adapter and folds it permanently into the model.**
- It is folded into a 16-bit copy, never the 4-bit one
- The result is one ordinary model, with no separate adapter file

note: **Adds the adapter's changes into the model's own numbers. The two become one ordinary model.**
